prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Journey", "body": "Select the path that matches how you want to interact with your desktop pet daily."}}

   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Upload Pet Photos", "body": "Upload clear photos from multiple angles for optimal 3D pet generation.", "components": [{"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Upload Front & Side Photos", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "preview", "label": "Live Angle Preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}

   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select your starter companion to personalize its visual traits and behavior.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Companion", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence: Reorders sign_in to occur right after adoption_certificate and before waiting screen generation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}

   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Your Pet is Arriving Soon", "body": "We are assembling your pet's desktop environment and rendering animations.", "components": [{"type": "timer", "label": "Estimated Time Remaining", "style": "emphasis"}]}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet Forever", "body": "Your account keeps your adopted pet, customization, and desktop progress safely backed up to the cloud."}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your pet anytime on the desktop to access settings, hide, or interact!", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Right-click pet on desktop to open quick menu controls.", "style": "highlight"}]}}

   config: {"new_desktop_launch": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet!", "body": "Your companion is now active on your desktop screen.", "components": [{"type": "image", "asset": "asset:desktop_guide", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Get Started", "action": "next"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_launch", "home_intro"]}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the choose_path screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning photo upload into a multi-angle creator flow inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning the pick_friend screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Reordering sign_in after adoption_certificate is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Adding an estimated time remaining indicator for a real wait process is allowed under Rules 4 and 5.
Adding desktop notifications to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Updating copy on the sign_in screen is allowed and complies with fair design rules.
Adding interaction hints to home_intro is allowed as home_intro is part of onboarding.
Adding a new onboarding screen prior to home_intro is allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the home_intro screen layout is allowed as part of onboarding.
